name: Triple Phoenix | 200mg Freeze Dried | Peaches
description: Peaches captured at the peak of freshness and infused with 200mg of THC per package (10pc per pack). All natural, no added sugars, and GMO-free, this is a healthier alternative to our confections. Great option for sharing or micro dosing. Great for a quick snack, or try it on cereal, oatmeal and yogurt. Easy to take on the go!
